name: codex
description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

codex_home.title: Codex home
codex_home.description: CODEX_HOME directory for every Codex process this plugin starts (auth, config, sessions). Overrides CODEX_HOME from your shell. ~ and $HOME are expanded.

auto_review.title: Auto-review approvals
auto_review.description: Let Codex ask for approval during /codex:rescue tasks (sandbox escapes, network access) and have its auto-review subagent approve or deny each request. When off, tasks never ask and stay inside their sandbox. Reviews and the stop-time review gate are unaffected.
